description: This file implements the ServerManagerModuleService class and related factory functions for managing server sessions via IPC, including configuration, state management, logging levels, and ping functionality.

classes.name: IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating server manager module services.

classes.name: ServerManagerModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Concrete factory class for creating ServerManagerModuleService instances.

classes.name: ServerManagerModuleService
classes.description: Implementation of the server manager module service handling configuration, state, logging, and ping requests.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a new IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a new ServerManagerModuleService instance, given a session server manager.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Handles setting configuration via IPC, delegating to session server manager.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Handles setting server state via IPC.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Handles setting log levels via IPC.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Handles ping requests via IPC, including validation of the IPC controller.
